title: Shunt thresholds in iNPH: model code and outputs
description: Python code and output files of a cost-effectiveness threshold analysis of shunt surgery versus no surgery for idiopathic normal pressure hydrocephalus in 21 European countries: share of the public long-term care expenditure of an untreated patient that the operation must avoid to pay for itself (s_dom = K/L), and QALY gain required when no care is avoided (q* = K/λ). Running the five scripts in the order given in the README reproduces the deposited files.
